regions.region: title, abstract, introduction, and ESI availability statement
regions.finding: Background citations and high-level claims were inventoried but not promoted to present-paper experiments; the online ESI statement does not establish an associated SI source.

regions.region: Results and discussion prose and Scheme 1
regions.finding: Three initial present-paper conditions were extracted separately: 1a and 1b give NR, while 1c gives 2c in 50% reported yield at 150 °C in dioxane.
Three alternative alkynes explicitly described as ineffective were retained as partial failed experiments; Table 2 interpretation and Scheme 2 context continue on page 2.

unresolved: Scheme 1 omits quantities, time, atmosphere, workup, purification, and the 50% yield basis.
The alternative-alkyne sentence omits the exact allene member and all experimental details.
The cited ESI was not supplied or explicitly associated.

regions.finding: All 15 solvent/temperature optimization rows were extracted independently; entry 12 was merged with Table 2 entry 1 and the exact 2c preparation.
All 10 substrate-scope rows were extracted; the ester and phosphine-oxide stoichiometry footnotes were applied only to their respective rows.
Scheme 2 was extracted as one experiment; ORTEP drawings for 2c and 4 were linked as structural evidence and not counted as reactions.

unresolved: Most table-only optimization rows omit scale, solvent volume, atmosphere, workup, and purification.
Complex structure assignments remain machine-derived and unverified.

regions.region: upper-left starting-material statements and General procedure
regions.finding: The cited starting-material methods were classified as literature-derived context rather than new row-level experiments; the explicit general TLC/concentration/chromatography operations were merged into the detailed product records.
Exact masses, amounts, solvent volumes, temperatures, times, product masses, and isolated yields were merged into their Table 2 records; 2c also merges Table 1 entry 12.

unresolved: Starting-material literature procedures are cited but not reproduced in experiment-level detail.

regions.finding: The cross-page 2g paragraph and the five phosphine-oxide scope preparations were merged with Table 2 rows; the unidentified 34 mg coproduct from 2g was retained without a guessed identity or yield.

The exact Scheme 2 preparation of 4 was merged into its page-2 arrow. The statement that Table 2 entries 4, 7, and 10 were reproduced was linked to those records rather than counted as new experiments.

regions.region: entire original page: reference list and crystallographic notes
regions.finding: No present-paper reaction arrow, table row, procedure, condition, or new result appears. References are citations, and crystal data for 2c/4 are characterization rather than reactions.

unresolved: Cited publications and CCDC files were not supplied as associated source documents and were not mined for reaction details.
